revision.why: The CB-B* inference nodes shipped degenerate (1 audit workflow + 3 brutalist roasts, code-verified): evidence-invariant regex priors, hand-bonus ranking, a sampler that ignores its factors, a trainer whose weights are never used.
revision.reframe: LLM-as-estimator. The agent is the estimator; the engine is the typed, calibrated, replayable, provenance-disciplined scaffold. See detail/PATH-A-PRIME.md.
decisions: Primary value is the deterministic differential tester (CB-D1): run runnable controls for hard labels; nearly free.

Secondary is one evidence-conditioned elicitation primitive (CB-B7), confined to advisory SCRATCH (writeBeliefSignalScratch), tagged llm_inferred, with a role guard; never the frontier-events ledger (which defaults unknown kinds to operator_asserted = laundering).
Factor-graph sum-product (CB-B4) demoted from deliverable to A/B hypothesis.
Calibration (CB-B5) is pooled cross-session only, shipped gated.
Belief-assisted scheduler priority stays gated off until an external-label loop-breaker exists (confirmation-loop guard).
